articles.title: World Biryani Day Revealed India's Best-Kept Secret: The Regional Rice Revolution Coming to a City Near You
articles.excerpt: From Naga smoked pork biryani to Awadhi dum, India's regional food traditions are finally breaking free of the butter-chicken box — and diaspora kitchens are leading the charge.
articles.image_caption: A steaming plate of Hyderabadi dum biryani layered with saffron-infused rice and tender meat
articles.nri_angle: NRIs are rediscovering India's regional culinary diversity beyond the butter-chicken standard, with diaspora kitchens and restaurants leading the charge.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Dosas, Biryani, and Bhangra: Toronto's Massive South Asian Street Festival Returns This Weekend
articles.excerpt: The 24th TD Festival of South Asia transforms Toronto's Little India into a two-day celebration of food, music, and diaspora community — and it is free.
articles.image_caption: Crispy pani puri arranged in a bowl, a beloved Indian street food staple found at diaspora festivals
articles.nri_angle: The 24th TD Festival of South Asia is one of the largest diaspora cultural events in North America, showcasing how South Asian food and culture thrive in Toronto's Little India community.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: From Homeless in Manhattan to Cooking for Its Mayor: Vikas Khanna's Extraordinary Full Circle
articles.excerpt: The Michelin-starred chef who once slept on New York's streets hosted Mayor Zohran Mamdani for Iftar at his restaurant Bungalow — a reunion 25 years in the making.
articles.image_caption: Chef Vikas Khanna, the Michelin-starred Indian chef and cultural ambassador based in New York
articles.nri_angle: Vikas Khanna's journey from homeless immigrant to Michelin-starred chef hosting NYC's mayor is the quintessential diaspora success story.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: From Fullerton to the Westside: How Khan Saab Became SoCal's First Michelin-Recognised Pakistani Restaurant
articles.excerpt: Chef Imran Ali Mookhi's halal craft kitchen, famous for its zero-proof cocktail bar and Wagyu kebabs, opens its third location on Santa Monica Boulevard this month.
articles.image_caption: Khan Saab, Southern California's first Michelin-recognised Pakistani restaurant, is expanding from Fullerton to Santa Monica (Wikimedia Commons)
articles.nri_angle: Khan Saab is SoCal's first Michelin-recognised Pakistani restaurant, offering halal fine dining and a zero-proof bar that removes barriers for South Asian diners who don't drink.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: A Michelin Chef, a Cancer Survivor, and a 7,500-Sq-Ft Love Letter to Old India: Zamindar's Clubhouse Opens in Charlotte
articles.excerpt: Hyderabad-trained chef Vamshi Krishna Adi brings his Michelin Bib Gourmand pedigree from New York to Charlotte's South End, in a restaurant inspired by the grand clubhouses of colonial-era India.
articles.image_caption: A serving of traditional Hyderabadi dum biryani, a signature dish on the Zamindar's Clubhouse menu
articles.nri_angle: Charlotte's growing Indian-American population finally gets a destination-worthy Indian restaurant, as a Michelin-recognized Hyderabadi chef brings NYC-calibre dining to the Southeast.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sold Out in Two Hours: How Indian Mangoes Became America's Most Coveted Summer Fruit
articles.excerpt: From Costco shelves to embassy tasting events, Alphonso and Kesar mangoes are fuelling a $10 million export boom — and a wave of NRI nostalgia.
articles.image_caption: Ripe Alphonso mangoes, the prized Indian variety now selling out at Costco stores across America
articles.nri_angle: Indian mangoes at Costco represent a profound shift for NRIs — the childhood taste of home is finally available in mainstream American retail, turning summer nostalgia into a booming export business.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: From Michelin Stars to Grocery Aisles: Gymkhana Brings Premium Indian Sauces to America
articles.excerpt: The two-Michelin-starred London restaurant's CPG line launches in Whole Foods nationwide, backed by an $8.5 million Series A as Indian cuisine enters its premium moment in the US.
articles.image_caption: A rich assortment of Indian spices and curry ingredients
articles.nri_angle: A Michelin-starred Indian brand entering American grocery shelves signals that Indian cuisine has arrived at the premium tier, validating what diaspora families have always known about their food.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: The Chipotle of Indian Food Is No Longer a Punchline
articles.excerpt: From Rasa's East Coast expansion to new openings in Columbus and Gastonia, Indian fast-casual dining is finally hitting its stride across America.
articles.image_caption: A vibrant Indian curry bowl with rice and fresh accompaniments
articles.nri_angle: The Indian fast-casual boom validates diaspora food culture while raising questions about how much simplification is needed to make Indian cuisine mainstream in America.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Your Mother's Haldi Doodh Is Now a $7 Turmeric Latte
articles.excerpt: As turmeric mentions surge 157 percent on American menus, NRIs are watching their grandmothers' remedies get repackaged — and repriced — as premium wellness trends.
articles.image_caption: Fresh turmeric root, the ancient Indian spice now trending as a wellness superfood
articles.nri_angle: NRIs are watching their grandmothers' kitchen remedies get rebranded as premium Western wellness trends — a bittersweet validation that raises questions about cultural ownership and pricing.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
